_comment: Per-project list of axe findings verified by hand to be measurement artifacts,
not real failures. Used by filter-known-artifacts.js. Ships empty on purpose.
Each entry: rule (the axe rule id), targets (substrings matched against the
node's selector), fgColor (optional — only match when axe reported this exact
foreground colour), reason (the evidence, which goes into the audit trail).
Example of a justified entry — delete it and write your own:
"reason": "axe reports fg #000000 while getComputedStyle returns rgb(255,255,255) in the same Playwright run. Real ratio 17.26:1, checked by hand in Chrome and Safari on 2026-08-26."
